name: forgot-password
title: Forgot password
description: The password-recovery screen of the mangacn auth flow, made only with the kit. A manga Panel: the picture you pass for each state (pictures), focus SpeedLines, a SpeechBubble ('Forgot it? It happens.', a shout bubble 'Huh?!' on error, 'Yes!' on success), a Manpu sweat drop and the Sfx ハッ. From 48rem of container width the panel stands full height on the start side of the form; narrower, it sits above the form in 4:3 with the character whole. The form, in a case (G1) when there is room: an email Field, a Send code Button with its loading state (the field stays enabled) and a 'Back to sign in' link. Errors with focus on the field: empty or invalid email; an unknown email (demo: an address containing 'unknown') shows a jagged accent box with a '!' mark that shakes, role=alert (G8). Success: an accent Stamp 'Sent!' and an 'Enter the code' button. Links call onNavigate and never navigate. One column on phones with 44px touch targets; container queries widen it. Works in light, dark, any accent and with Radix or Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/forgot-password". The root fills its container width; the panel and the form sit side by side once the block is 48rem wide. Wire onNavigate to your router and replace the simulated timeout in submit with your own call. Pass pictures (one image URL per state: idle, error, done) to fill the panel; the block ships no image.

meta.tagline: A manga panel beside a one-field recovery form that stamps “Sent!”.
meta.usage:
import { ForgotPassword } from "@/components/manga/blocks/forgot-password"

<ForgotPassword className="min-h-svh" onNavigate={(screen) => router.push(`/${screen}`)} />

props.name: pictures
props.type: { idle?: string; error?: string; done?: string }
props.description: Image URLs for the panel, one per state. Without them the panel shows its speed lines only.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and placement of the whole interface.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called by 'Back to sign in' and 'Enter the code'. Without it these do nothing.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: The title's heading level: "h1" when the block is the page, "h2" inside a page that already has its h1.
